text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A member of Narita Top Road's generation 
makes her debut. —T.M. Opera O. Though the 
King of the Opera lost her first race, she 
swaggered that it wouldn't be fun 
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Admire Vega made her debut. 
Although she crossed the finish line 
first, she was demoted due to 
interference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"If I cannot turn this humiliation into 
strength, I do not even deserve to 
run"—Admire Vega's eyes were already fixed 
on the goal she aimed to reach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by the powerful running of her 
peers, Narita Top Road redoubles her 
determination. She vowed to chase after 
the backs of those two.
